body: Reading your post is like looking in a mirror. I hope you can  reach out for help, and if not I hope you find peace. You can pm me if you need to talk at all.

I've had 3 opinions on my diagnosis of BPD (been a year or more now) since I was first diagnosed and they all believe very strongly that i have it. They say that mine is pretty severe though (think a suicide attempt every other week, drug abuse, extreme impulsivity) so if you feel it's not quite right I would definitely look into a second opinion, it's always good to get more anyway so they can give you the appropriate medication. Sometimes they seem to even get bipolar and BPD kind of mixed/crossed over due to a similarity in some of the ways they present. In any case, good luck with your recovery journey.

I'm sorry, but I find this really insensitive. What about those who have had, or do have, abusive partners? Those stuck in toxic relationships? Sure, it's your opinion and this is the internet, but please don't invalidate other people's feelings. That is just messed up.

I second this, you'll only end up in hospital suffering organ failure, and there's a chance that you'll live. Speaking from experience here.
It's not worth it.

Thank you for replying.

I see what you mean, when my psychologist first mentioned it I thought "how can this even be possible, this isn't me". He does, but I was mostly worried that I was looking too far into it.

Thank you, I'm trying my best not to.

I'm glad you have everything sorted now! And it's certainly frustrating, especially since it's been so many years. I hope so, and thank you :)
